systems.platform: geolocation application; six-digit unique address codes
systems.tiers: about 1,500,000 places and parcels in the ten communes of Bamako District, neighbouring communes of Kati cercle and the town of Ségou; deployment under way in Koulikoro and Sikasso (March 2025)

note: A digital addressing system presented to government on 10 March 2025; a land and address system, with nothing on civil registration.
